query: What roles are animated in the hero tagline, and how does the typewriter timing work?

query: How does the navbar determine the active section while scrolling?

validation_focus: Exact component behavior and numeric grounding.

query: How many projects are currently defined, and what are their names?

query: Which project is the repository-aware RAG assistant, and what retrieval/evaluation features does it claim?
expected_answer_notes: CodeSeek is the repository-aware RAG assistant. It claims local-first repository-aware RAG, Qdrant vector search, in-process BM25, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, 10 intent families, two-layer source attribution, and a retrieval-evaluation harness using DeepEval and pytest.
validation_focus: Exact project feature grounding and retrieval terminology.

query: Which projects are in the quant/trading category, and what distinguishes each one?
expected_answer_notes: RL Trading Agent and Grid Trading Bot V3. RL Trading Agent: offline RL research system using LSTM actor-critic PPO for continuous long/short position sizing from crypto market sequences. Grid Trading Bot V3: production-oriented algorithmic trading platform with Python/FastAPI runtime, real-time telemetry, paper-trading engine, recovery-safe persistence, and Next.js dashboard.
validation_focus: Exact category grouping and project distinction grounding.

query: How do project cards decide whether to render Code and Live links?
expected_answer_notes: Projects maps over projects. Code link renders only when p.code exists and is not "#". Live link renders only when p.live exists and is not "#".

query: How does the contact form send messages, and when does it show an error?
expected_answer_notes: Contact uses EmailJS sendForm with NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID, NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID, and NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_PUBLIC_KEY. If any env var is missing, it sets error status before sending. On success it shows success, resets form, returns to idle after 5 seconds; on failure it shows error.
validation_focus: Exact form integration and error handling behavior.
